```{=html}
<style>

<div id="tonight-plan"></div>

<script>
(function(){
  const finals = [
    { name: "IR 362 (Hammad)", date: null, color: "primary", url: "ir362/", tbd: true, priorityScore: 1, note: "Date needs Brightspace/syllabus confirmation; treat as urgent because it is 65% and within the USC final window." },
    { name: "ECON 205 (Pérez)", date: "2026-05-11T14:00:00", color: "primary", url: "econ205/", verified: true, note: "Known slot: Mon May 11, 2:00–4:00 PM." },
    { name: "ACCT 410x/410 (Leventhal)", date: "2026-05-11T16:30:00", color: "secondary", url: "acct410x/", verified: false, note: "USC Registrar lists Accounting 410: Mon May 11, 4:30–6:30 PM; verify Hanna's section in Brightspace." },

  const now = new Date();
  finals.forEach(f => {

      f.priorityScore = f.daysOut;
    }
  });
  finals.sort((a,b) => a.priorityScore - b.priorityScore);

  // Daily sequencing logic
  const today = new Date();

  let html = `<h2>Today is ${dayOfWeek}</h2>`;

  finals.forEach((f, idx) => {
    const cls = !f.date ? 'upcoming' : (f.daysOut <= 2 ? 'urgent' : (f.daysOut <= 5 ? 'upcoming' : 'distant'));
    const dayWord = f.daysOut === 1 ? 'day' : 'days';
    let priorityLabel = idx === 0 ? '🔥 Top priority tonight' : (idx === 1 ? '🎯 Secondary focus' : '📅 Background work');
    let dateBlock = f.date
      ? `${f.daysOut} ${dayWord} away · ${new Date(f.date).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric'})}${f.verified ? ' · verified' : ' · verify section'}`
      : `Date/due time needs verification`;

    html += `<div class="day-block ${cls}">
      <h3>${priorityLabel} — ${f.name}</h3>
      <div class="meta">${dateBlock} · ${f.note}</div>
      <ol>${getTasks(f, idx).map(t => `<li><input type="checkbox" class="checkbox">${t}</li>`).join('')}</ol>
    </div>`;
  });

  html += `<div class="callout callout-style-default callout-tip" style="margin-top:1.5rem;padding:1rem 1.2rem;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(46,125,50,0.05);border-left:4px solid #2e7d32;">
    <strong>Habit reminder:</strong> 90 minutes of focused work · 15 minute break · repeat. Phone in another room. Water, snack, no Twitter. The work is the work.
  </div>`;

  document.getElementById('tonight-plan').innerHTML = html;

  function getTasks(f, idx) {
    const days = f.date ? f.daysOut : (f.name.startsWith("IR 362") ? 2 : 99);
    const isPrimary = idx === 0;
    const tasks = [];

    if (f.name.startsWith("ECON")) {

        tasks.push("90-min walk + dinner + sleep by 11 PM");

      } else if (days <= 3) {
        tasks.push("Take <a href='econ205/mock-exam-b.html'>Mock Exam B</a> under timed conditions (120 min, no notes)");

        tasks.push("Drill <a href='econ205/killer-traps.html'>Killer Traps</a> on those 3 topics");
      } else if (days <= 5) {
        tasks.push("Take <a href='econ205/mock-exam-a.html'>Mock Exam A</a> under timed conditions");
        tasks.push("Review key, label every error: trap / forgot formula / arithmetic");
        tasks.push(isPrimary ? "Run <a href='econ205/active-recall.html'>Active Recall §2</a> — at least 30 cards" : "Skim <a href='econ205/cram-sheet.html'>Cram Sheet</a>");
      } else {
        tasks.push("Read <a href='econ205/cram-sheet.html'>Cram Sheet</a> end-to-end");
        tasks.push("Run <a href='econ205/active-recall.html'>Active Recall §1</a> (pre-midterm) — 30 cards");
        tasks.push("Skim <a href='econ205/diagrams.html'>Diagram Bank</a> if available");
      }
    } else if (f.name.startsWith("ACCT")) {
      if (days <= 1) {
        tasks.push("Light skim of <a href='acct410x/cheat-sheet.html'>Cheat Sheet</a>");
        tasks.push("Read <a href='acct410x/day-of.html'>Day-Of Playbook</a>");
        tasks.push("Sleep");
      } else if (days <= 3) {
        tasks.push("Take <a href='acct410x/mock-final.html'>Mock Final</a> timed");
        tasks.push("Run <a href='acct410x/trap-drills.html'>Trap Drills</a> on the 4 high-yield areas");
        tasks.push("Read <a href='acct410x/walkthroughs.html'>Walkthroughs</a> if available");
      } else {
        tasks.push("Memorize <a href='acct410x/cheat-sheet.html'>Cheat Sheet</a> formulas");
        tasks.push("Drill indirect-method cash flow questions specifically");
        tasks.push(isPrimary ? "Take <a href='acct410x/mock-final.html'>Mock Final</a> diagnostic" : "Skim <a href='acct410x/index.qmd'>Strategic Brief</a>");
      }
    } else if (f.name.startsWith("IR 362")) {
      if (days <= 1) {
        tasks.push("Read <a href='ir362/cram-sheet.html'>Cram Sheet</a> end-to-end");
        tasks.push("Memorize all dates in the cram-sheet table");
        tasks.push("Sleep with the page on your phone");
      } else if (days <= 3) {
        tasks.push("Pick a <a href='ir362/mock-essays.html'>Mock Essay Prompt</a>; outline + write under 30-min timer");
        tasks.push("Compare your answer to the sample; mark every missing citation");
        tasks.push("Re-skim <a href='ir362/frames/'>Hammad's 7 Frames</a>");
      } else {
        tasks.push("Read <a href='ir362/index.html'>Framework</a> — all 17 questions");
        tasks.push("Read 1 deep-dive: <a href='ir362/iran-axis.html'>Iran/Axis</a> or <a href='ir362/abraham-accords.html'>Abraham Accords</a>");
        tasks.push(isPrimary ? "Run flashcard deck — IR 362 (<a href='flashcards.html'>here</a>)" : "Read 1 lecture frame from <a href='ir362/frames/'>Frames</a>");
      }
      tasks.unshift("Verify final date/time in Brightspace or syllabus before using any countdown");
    } else if (f.name.startsWith("Marketing")) {
      tasks.push("Open <a href='marketing/index.html'>Marketing</a> and write the current deliverable in one sentence");
      tasks.push("Ask Hanna for the syllabus, grading rubric, deadline, and any professor-provided pitch-deck template");
      tasks.push("Draft the Ensemble pitch spine: user, problem, alternative, differentiation, proof, risk");
    }
    return tasks;
  }
})();
</script>
```

## How this page works

This page reads the date and the known final-exam dates, then separates verified dates from date placeholders. It updates automatically, but anything marked "verify" should be checked against Brightspace before Hanna relies on it.

The three priority levels:

- 🔥 **Top priority** — the closest verified exam, or the highest-risk unverified item; spend 60–70% of tonight on it
- 🎯 **Secondary focus** — the next-closest; 20–30% of tonight
- 📅 **Background** — the more distant; 10–20% to keep momentum

The checkboxes are local-only (your browser remembers them) — they reset if you clear browser data, which is fine. The point is the *act* of checking off, not the persistence.

## When to break the auto-plan

- **You did poorly on a mock today.** Override and drill the weak area, regardless of which course is closest.
- **You're cooked.** Skip the lower-priority finals tonight; full sleep > marginal study after 11 PM.
- **A friend wants to study together.** Take it. Group study is rare-but-good if both people commit. Use the [Connections](connections.qmd) page to bridge across courses.
- **A date is unverified.** Check [Source Check](accuracy-notes.qmd), then Brightspace. Do not let a placeholder date make the plan look more certain than it is.

::: {.callout-warning}
**The biggest mistake right now is over-planning.** Read the top block. Do those tasks. Don't second-guess the sequence. The compounding wins from consistent execution beat the marginal gains from re-optimizing the schedule every night.
:::
